headline: Meloni | 21 Billion Euros Less in Taxes Every Year in Italians' Pockets; To SMEs | The State Should Be an Ally, Not an Enemy
summary: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni announced a reduction of 21 billion euros in taxes per year for Italians. She said the state should be an ally, not an enemy, of small and medium-sized enterprises.
why: Tax policy shapes household disposable income, corporate costs and public finances, all of which matter for Italian government debt and growth.
